sentences.text: This dinosaur was approximately 9 to 10 meters long.
The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — includes vertebrae, rib fragments, chevrons, and parts of the pelvis.
Fossils of Xiangyunloong were found in the Early Jurassic Fengjiahe Formation within the Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture of Yunnan, China.
The genus name references Xiangyun County, meaning 'auspicious clouds', while the species name honors Luming town and the dinosaur-bird connection.
Distinctive features include lateral expansions on cervical neural spines, a heightened hyposphene in dorsal vertebrae, and a flaring supracetabular crest on the ilium.
It belongs to the parent group Massopoda and is classified in the class Saurischia.
This animal lived between 201.4 and 174.7 million years ago, spanning from the Hettangian to the Toarcian.
Phylogenetic analysis places Xiangyunloong in an unresolved polytomy with Xingxiulong species, situated between Massospondylidae and Sauropodiformes in an unresolved clade.
